recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-8213; any future generated-diagram or historical-extension cleanup should remain tied to the later Specimen processing-time issue family rather than this DSTU1 request.
issue_request: FHIR-8213 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core OO change request raised for DSTU1 asking how to record Specimen fixation or in-formalin times. The approved motion was to add treatmentTime[x] dateTime | Period 0..1 to specimen.treatment.
initial_application: The historical SVN-imported application commit 348686f20075ff53db8f62afc2a7a25ce7b99e57, whose subject included #8213, added Specimen.treatment.time[x] with cardinality 0..1 and type dateTime|Period to the Specimen spreadsheet. Later source conversion/refactoring carried the concept forward as Specimen.processing.time[x].
additional_context: Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative source has Specimen.processing.time[x] at 0..1, includes dateTime and Period choices, and explicitly mentions sample fixation and time in formalin. Later issue FHIR-40950, already represented on the combined branch, intentionally added Duration to this same element and reconciled the redundant specimen-processingTime extension; the FHIR Extension Pack version-tags that extension through FHIR 5.0 and states that R6 replaces it with Specimen.processing.time[x]. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the obsolete treatmentTime name or narrowing the current type list back to only dateTime|Period would conflict with later accepted Specimen processing-time decisions, while the current source already satisfies the FHIR-8213 request.

Extension-pack context for replacing specimen-processingTime with the core Specimen.processing.time[x] element.
